references.title: Google Street View, Hämeentie 52, May 2022, westward285-degree front and actual upward view

observations: Pale yellow curved street front with six upper window rows; plain pale frames and darker projecting sills.
A central shallow projecting bay has three narrow windows per row. Source-projected bay placement is approximate, around40% of the south-to-north front.
Dark tiled ground-floor shop base with wood-toned glazing frames and doors, a pale shop fascia and restrained roof edge. The actual upper view resolved all six rows.
limitations: Only the continuous low eastern curved frontage is repainted. The taller northern attic/gable and unobserved north/courtyard walls are excluded.
The native curved facets are unchanged. The drawing uses a common north-south projected coordinate, not a surveyed arc length.
Opening dimensions, column spacing and bay placement are original visual approximations; the observed six-row count is retained. Commercial lettering and reference tree/traffic pixels are omitted.
